Превращаем открытую террасу в любимую комнату дома. Защита от израильского ветра и пыли. Напишите СТЕКЛО в WhatsApp. #остеклениебалкона #безрамноеостекление #балкон #пергола #израиль

👉 reels.tepexa.com/w/5347ab92bdba713bdb58
why:
Серия Балкон + пергола. Вирусный донор с 11 млн просмотров о преображении неиспользуемого пространства балкона для привлечения охватов.
Часть кадров — из вирусного ролика вашей ниши (240.0 млн просмотров), чтобы разогнать охват; ваш продукт и призыв — в начале и в конце.
rules: Roman Group (ArtVitrage) works ONLY with glass. Main product (about 2 of 3 videos): frameless glazing of balconies and verandas (windows for balconies), pergolas, balcony blinds. Also: stained glass, decorative mirrors, glass kitchen backsplashes (skinali), glass partitions. EVERY shot must clearly show glass work as the main subject. Forbidden shots: kitchens or rooms where cabinets, appliances or furniture are the subject and no glass is clearly visible in focus; furniture or cabinets being built or assembled; woodwork; drinking glasses, glassware, bottles or jars; tiles, plaster or other trades; mosques, churches and religious images (synagogue stained glass only from his own photos). Never mention furniture. No prices, no deadlines, no client names, no other companies' objects.

problems: Frames 4.5 through 8.4 are nearly identical static angles of the same empty balcony with minimal movement
Pacing drops severely after frame 2 with slow, repetitive panning across the same glass panes
Final end screen at 9.7 is a plain solid graphic card rather than showcasing finished glass projects behind the CTA
qa.fix: Replace the static repeating views of the balcony with dynamic clips showing the glass sliding open/shut smoothly and put the final WhatsApp CTA over real video footage of a finished glazed terrace.
